name: shoot-4414
about: 4414 preloaded with 8 in its ALLIANCE ZONE in TELEOP: the turret swings round on its motor against its energy chain, the flywheel spins to their fits' speed, the hood tilts, the Dye Rotor feeds its load up the bore and the sushi feeder into the flywheel and over into the HUB (scored); then it drives out past the zone line, intakes, and passes back (M3c).
